question: What is the full form of NADA?
solution:
The correct answer is __**National Anti - Doping Agency**__.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

 
• It was established by the Government of India as an autonomous body under the Ministry of Youth Affairs and Sports.
 
• NADA's primary objective is to ensure fair play and protect the rights of clean athletes.
 
• It implements the World Anti-Doping Code (WADC), which is the global standard for anti-doping policies, rules, and regulations.
 
• NADA conducts testing of athletes both in and out of competition to detect the presence of prohibited substances or methods.
 
• It collects urine and blood samples from athletes for analysis in WADA-accredited laboratories.
 
• NADA also conducts educational programs to raise awareness about the dangers of doping and the importance of clean sport.
 
• It works closely with National Sports Federations (NSFs) and other stakeholders to implement effective anti-doping measures.
 
• NADA handles the results management process, which includes reviewing test results and determining appropriate sanctions for anti-doping rule violations.
 
• It has the authority to impose sanctions on athletes who are found to have violated anti-doping rules, including suspensions from competition.
 
• NADA also investigates potential anti-doping rule violations based on intelligence and information received.
 
• It works to promote research on anti-doping methods and to develop new testing techniques.
 
• NADA's work helps to maintain the integrity of sports and to ensure that athletes compete on a level playing field.
